name: improving quantization performance
problem: How can we improve the performance of quantized LLMs

hypotheses.statement: investigate the imatrix technique and see if we can improve it using custom data or a new optimization metric

experiments.title: outlier_max rescue + heavy-tail signal mixing
experiments.summary: F cells (tensor-class signal swap) regressed KLD to ~0.60 vs. outlier_max's 0.562 — per-block bit allocation requires uniform signal type across tensors. H4 (max(L1(E[a²]), L1(√E[a⁴]))) set a new KLD low of 0.493 (vs. outlier_l4 0.499) but tied outlier_l4 on every tool-call metric inside noise. Outlier_l4 remains the recommended default.
